mentions.name: feedinweb.com
mentions.description: A web project the author has been building as a hobby for the past few years, now seeking a collaborator to help grow and scale it with users while experimenting to discover what it can become.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the past few years I have been building feedinweb.com , I was working it as a hobby project as of now but now I feel like I want someone to grow this project and scale it up with users and then see what it can do.
